title: fix(plugin-chatbot,app-shell): an incremental edit (`kind: 'edit'`) is never read as a whole-app build (objectui#10109)
body:
Fixes #10109

Clause-②: yes — `DraftReview` is exported from `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`'s entry, and this PR adds an optional `kind` field to it. The widening is small, but it is on the published surface.

## What changed

An `apply_edit` result says `kind: 'edit'` on its envelope, and its `drafted[]` can list the `app` artifact the edit re-staged: an `add_object` op re-stages it for the nav merge. An `apply_blueprint` build carries no `kind`. Every reader that asks "did this finish a whole-app build?" now uses the producer's `kind` to tell the two apart, instead of guessing a build from the staged artifact types. An envelope without `kind` behaves exactly as before. `autoPublishable` is not read as a second whole-app signal.

Round 1 (`packages/plugin-chatbot/src/mapMessages.ts`):
- `detectBuiltAppPackage` returns `undefined` for an envelope that says `kind: 'edit'`, before it looks at `drafted[]`. This covers both the drafted posture and the auto-publish (`status: 'published'`) posture.

Round 2 (the seat's answer A on the card):
- `DraftReview` gains an optional `kind?: 'edit'`. `detectDraftResult` fills it from the envelope. It declares only the value its readers act on, so an envelope that says anything else leaves it unset. The edit still gets its draft card, its items and its `packageId`, so one-click publish still works.
- `buildProgressFromDraftReview` builds no finished "Built X" panel for a draft review whose `kind` is `'edit'`. A reloaded edit now shows what it showed live.
- `packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx`: the draft-review fallback in the `builtPackageId` memo no longer moves an edit to Studio. It reads `kind` straight off `tool.draftReview`, which round 3 types as `DraftReview`.
- `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useChatConversation.ts`: `CachedDraftReview` and `draftReviewToCachedResult` keep `kind`, so the envelope rebuilt for a cache-fallback reload still says `kind: 'edit'`, and the round-1 guard still applies.

Round 3 (after the contract review of `fb2a20e`):
- `ChatToolInvocation.draftReview` in `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`, which is published as `ChatbotEnhancedToolInvocation['draftReview']`, is now typed as `DraftReview` instead of an inline copy of its fields. The two copies were field-identical until round 2 added `kind`, which left the published tool-invocation type under-declaring what the runtime delivers. The copy's field docs move onto `DraftReview`, so the published type keeps them. The `DraftReview` upcast in `AiChatPage.tsx` became redundant and was dropped. The `DraftReview.kind` doc now names the readers that actually check it. All of this is type and comment only: the emitted JavaScript of `AiChatPage.tsx`, `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` and `mapMessages.ts` is byte-identical between `fb2a20e` and `f7eaadc` (TypeScript `transpileModule` with comments removed, compared by SHA-256).

Tests: `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/mapMessages.builtAppEditEnvelope-10109.test.ts` (extended), `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useChatConversation.editKindRoundTrip-10109.test.ts` (new), and `packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/AiChatPage.builtTransition.test.tsx` (three new cases; its existing `apply_blueprint` reopen, auto-publish and live-build pins are the controls). Changesets: `.changeset/10109-edit-envelope-not-built-app.md` (`@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`: minor, for the added type field) and `.changeset/10109-app-shell-edit-not-built-moment.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell`: patch).

## Red, then green

The pins were committed on their own first (`aa52689`) and run against the source as it was before round 2: `Tests  5 failed | 13 passed (18)`. The five red cases:
- the draft review carries `kind: 'edit'`;
- a reloaded edit builds no done panel;
- the cache round trip keeps `kind`;
- reopening a drafted-posture edit stays out of Studio;
- a live edit completion stays out of Studio.

Every `apply_blueprint` control was green. The published-posture reopen was also green, because the round-1 guard already covered it. With the fix (`fb2a20e`) the result is `Tests  18 passed (18)`.

Then each fix site was removed on its own at `fb2a20e`, using `ablation-replace.mjs --delete`. Every mutation was proven on disk (anchor x1 to x0, blob changed), and every restore was proven (blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty):

| site removed | result | red cases |
|---|---|---|
| `detectDraftResult` lifting `kind` | 4 failed, 14 passed | draft-review kind, reload panel, cache round trip, drafted reopen |
| `buildProgressFromDraftReview` guard | 2 failed, 16 passed | reload panel, cache round trip (its reload-panel assertion) |
| AiChatPage fallback `kind` check | 2 failed, 16 passed | drafted reopen, live completion |
| cache keeps `kind` | 1 failed, 17 passed | cache round trip |
| round-1 guard in `detectBuiltAppPackage` (re-run after round 2) | 5 failed, 13 passed | both unit postures, both reopen postures, cache round trip |

In every run the only red cases were edit cases, and no `apply_blueprint` control went red.

Reverse check on the rebuilt `.d.ts`: app-shell's test project resolves `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` through `dist`. In a typed probe there, `DraftReview` with `kind: 'edit'` compiled (exit 0), and `kind: 'build'` failed with `TS2322: Type '"build"' is not assignable to type '"edit"'`. Both were restored.

## Local verification (HEAD `fb2a20e`, with `origin/main` `0d39dc6` merged in; merged, not rebased)

- `turbo run build --filter="@object-ui/app-shell^..." --concurrency=2`: 28 successful, 28 total.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-chatbot type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (each is `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0 each. The test projects' `--listFilesOnly` includes the new and extended pins.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/` plus the 34 test files outside plugin-chatbot that name `AiChatPage` or `useChatConversation` (app-shell, apps/console, components, i18n): `Test Files  83 passed (83)`, `Tests  856 passed (856)`. This is a narrowed run: test files that reach these modules only indirectly, without naming them, are not in it. The full app-shell suite is left to CI.
- `check-changeset-presence`: "6 source file(s) of 2 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 2 changeset(s)".
- `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-control-bytes`, `check-vi-mock-specifiers`, `check-vi-mock-inherit`, `check-vi-mock-override-shape`, `check-test-path-roots`, `check-shell-escape-residue`, `check:esm-specifiers`: exit 0 each.
- `check:new-line-citations`: "VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)".
- `check-changeset-claims`: exit 0 (report-only). It flags `.changeset/6169-chatbot-authoring-face-type.md` (names `AiChatPage.tsx`, about the `autoResponse` fields) and `.changeset/8214-chatbot-anypart-state-widen.md` (names `mapMessages.ts`, about `AnyPart.state`). I read both, and both still hold.
- `check-readme-exports`: NOT MEASURED. It needs every package built, and the run said "the population COLLAPSED -- this run proves nothing". Left to CI.
- Lint on the six changed TS files: 0 errors. The 35 warnings are all in `AiChatPage.tsx` and `useChatConversation.ts`, and the same two files at `0d39dc6` give the same 35. None is on a changed line. Linting is not type-aware (empty `parserOptions`), so this diff cannot change the verdict on any untouched file. The full `pnpm lint` is left to CI.

## Round 3 verification (HEAD `f7eaadc`, with `origin/main` `ff14e29` merged in; merged, not rebased)

- Typed probe through the published type: in app-shell's test project, which resolves `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` through `dist`, a function that takes a `ChatbotEnhancedToolInvocation` and returns `tool.draftReview?.kind` failed at `fb2a20e` with `TS2339: Property 'kind' does not exist on type '{ items: ...` and compiled at `f7eaadc` (exit 0). The same probe bytes were used both times, and it was removed after each run.
- `turbo run build` of the app-shell closure (28 successful) at the old head, then of plugin-chatbot (9 successful) at the new head. The rebuilt `dist/ChatbotEnhanced.d.ts` declares `draftReview?: DraftReview`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-chatbot type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0 each.
- The 18-case pin set: `Tests  18 passed (18)`. The AiChatPage fallback site was ablated again because the declaration it reads through changed: `Tests  2 failed | 16 passed (18)` (drafted reopen, live completion), then restored. The other sites' lines are unchanged, so their ablations were not re-run.
- Gates, exit 0 each: `check-changeset-presence` ("7 source file(s) of 2 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 2 changeset(s)"), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-package-self-import`, `check-control-bytes`, `check-vi-mock-specifiers`, `check-vi-mock-inherit`, `check-vi-mock-override-shape`, `check-test-path-roots`, `check-shell-escape-residue`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new). `check-changeset-claims` (report-only) now also flags `.changeset/6687-chatbot-surface-authorable.md`, which names `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` about `ChatbotSurface`; that paragraph still holds.
- Lint on the three changed source files: 0 errors, with the same warning counts as at `fb2a20e` (`ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` 10, `AiChatPage.tsx` 31, `mapMessages.ts` 0).

## Acceptance notes

- **Standing gap.** The cloud envelope shape is NOT MEASURED (cloud unreachable). Every `kind` read here (`apply_edit` answering `kind: 'edit'`, `apply_blueprint` carrying none) rests on the producer seat's filing on the card. Whether the producer change is live in the cloud repository, and which `.objectui-sha` it pins, is also NOT MEASURED. Nothing in objectui or in the installed `@objectstack/*` 17.4.0 declares `kind` on the chat tool-result envelope.
